instruction: Notify the owner with the exact action, payout, deadline, risk, prepared artifacts and evidence; continue all reversible work meanwhile.

evidence: Amazon Affiliate Site Development 6 days left I'm looking for an experienced web developer to create an Amazon affiliate shopping website. The site will primarily serve to sell Amazon products through reviews, price comparisons, and best deal recommendations. Key requirements: - Layout: Carousel view - Categories: Electronics, Clothing, Home & Kitchen, Groceries Ideal skills and experience: - Expertise in affiliate marketing websites - Proficiency in creating carousel view layouts - Experience with Amazon's affiliate program - Strong knowledge of product categories: electronics, clothing, home & kitchen, groceries - SEO optimization skills to drive traffic Please provide samples of previous similar work and estimated delivery time. Notr Affiliate Marketing Content Management System (CMS) CSS HTML PHP SEO Web Design Web Development Website Design Website Development $16 - $131 $16 - $131 0 bids Bid now
human_actions: Authorize use of a truthful Freelancer.com account and review/accept the platform terms so Louis OS can submit the already prepared proposal or quote. Do not complete KYC or configure payout unless the platform explicitly requests it later.
payment_methods: Freelancer milestone payment; account payout method selected after award
rationale: hours and page volume are scoring inputs, not standalone rejection gates
headline prize size is not used as the primary ranking signal
items.risk_summary: risk=0.20; platform account and terms gate only; KYC, payout and contract actions remain deferred until explicitly required
